facts.text: Sam is struggling with weight and feels it is affecting their confidence.

evidence.quote: Yeah, I'm struggling with my weight and it's affecting my confidence. I feel like I can't overcome all the challenges with my weight, I keep lacking motivation.

facts.text: Evan encourages Sam to take small steps and try new things to build confidence.

evidence.quote: Stepping out of your comfort zone can be intimidating, but it's totally worth it. Just challenge yourself to try something new, even if it's just a little thing. You got this!
Thanks, Evan. I'll take your advice. Trying new things can be difficult.

facts.text: Evan mentions that hiking is a great way to center oneself and be one with nature.

evidence.quote: I remember you mentioning that! Hiking is indeed a great way to center oneself and be one with nature.
